items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the transportation corporations law, in relation to restricting transportation corporations that are electric corporations from exercising the right of eminent domain
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S6612

TITLE OF BILL:
An act
to amend the transportation corporations law, in relation to restricting
transportation corporations that are electric corporations from
exercising the right of eminent domain

PURPOSE:
To limit efforts to use eminent domain to public purposes.

SUMMARY OF PROVISION:
Provides that electric corporations that seek to
build transmission lines connecting a location outside the
territorial limits of the United States, to a location within the
State of New York, or electric corporations seeking to build an
electric facility outside the United States and inter-collecting to
a location within the State, shall not be afforded the power of
eminent domain.

JUSTIFICATION:
The power of eminent domain should be used to achieve
public purposes that inure to the benefit of the State. Transmission
and generation projects that originate outside the territorial limits
of the United States do not sufficiently benefit New York State and
do not encourage employment opportunities or economic development
within the State. Such projects will (1) discourage repowering of
existing generating facilities within the State, (2) discourage the
rebuilding of existing transmission lines in the State, and (3)
discourage the building of new transmission lines and generating
facilities, including renewable resources, within the State.
Construction and development of these facilities and infrastructure
in New York State, rather than outside the country, maximizes
employment and economic development in New York State and in our
nation.
Furthermore, by importing power from outside the United States, our
nation's dependency on foreign imports of energy is increased.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:
This is a new bill.

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:
None.

LOCAL FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:
None.

EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Restricts eminent domain powers of transportation corporations that are electric corporations under certain circumstances where projects extend beyond territorial borders of the United States.
title: Relates to restricting eminent domain powers of transportation corporations that are electric corporations
